MOD = 1000000007
MAX_SIZE = 33

def multiply(m1, m2, size):
    res = [[0]*(size+1) for _ in range(size+1)]
    for i in range(size+1):
        for j in range(size+1):
            sum_ = 0
            for p in range(size+1):
                sum_ = (sum_ + m1[i][p] * m2[p][j]) % MOD
            res[i][j] = sum_
    return res

n, k = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize result matrix as identity
result = [[0]*(k+1) for _ in range(k+1)]
for i in range(k+1):
    result[i][i] = 1

# Build transition matrices
transition = []
for p in range(k):
    matrix = []
    for i in range(k+1):
        row = []
        for j in range(k+1):
            row.append(1 if (i == j or i == p) else 0)
        matrix.append(row)
    transition.append(matrix)

# Convert n to base-k digits
digits = []
temp = n
while temp > 0:
    digits.append(temp % k)
    temp //=k
digits.append(0)
# Compute partial sums in reverse
for i in range(len(digits)-2, -1, -1):
    digits[i] += digits[i+1]

# Main loop over digits
for p in range(len(digits)-1):
    for i in range(digits[p]-1, digits[p+1]-1, -1):
        result = multiply(result, transition[i % k], k)
    pre = [None]*k
    suf = [None]*k
    pre[0] = transition[0]
    for i in range(1, k):
        pre[i] = multiply(pre[i-1], transition[i], k)
    suf[k-1] = transition[k-1]
    for i in range(k-2, -1, -1):
        suf[i] = multiply(transition[i], suf[i+1], k)
    result = multiply(result, suf[0], k)
    for i in range(1, k):
        result = multiply(suf[i], pre[i-1], k)

# Sum over the last row
total = 0
for i in range(k+1):
    total += result[i][k]
print(total % MOD)
